source: Each active version has its own nightly releases which are generated automatically. For more about enabling the Nuxt nightly release channel, see {0}the nightly release channel docs{/0}.
text: Jede aktive Version hat eigene Nightly-Releases, die automatisch erzeugt werden. Mehr dazu, wie du den Nightly-Release-Kanal von Nuxt aktivierst, findest du in {0}der Dokumentation zum Nightly-Release-Kanal{/0}.
